We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 6 reactions, using templates in order: ['20810', '2895', '1914397', '1914398', '1914399', '74054'].

We have applied first two templates, got products (precursors). Need to continue applying remaining templates sequentially to each resulting molecule? Typically each step splits a molecule into precursors. We need a route tree where each reaction uses given template ID. Starting from target molecule, apply 20810 -> gives two precursors: precursor A = "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1" and precursor B = "O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1F". Then apply 2895 to precursor A (maybe) to get new precursor(s). The result gave one product: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1". So nitration? So after step 2 we have new precursor A2 and B unchanged.

Now need to apply template 1914397 to some molecule (maybe B or A2). We need to check applicability. Let's try applying to B (the sulfonyl chloride).
